bible_refs: EMAIL-400/411/426 Whitaker uses Alder packet copies
rationale: Replaces the one-line KW stubs (8 ledgers, 7 applications, 8 dates logs) with the documents the carrier bodies describe. Uses byte-preserving splice: only the attachment part changes, and headers, bodies, boundaries and inline logos are untouched. Money: the Option Fee is $12,000 per parcel, paid as three $4,000 Option Payments per the executed Schedule 1. There is no lump sum. CSV amounts are unformatted (4000.00 / 12000.00), and no new dollar figures are introduced. KW-02 (Eff. 9/20/22): P1 due 9/27/22, Chk 10417 dated 9/23/22, cleared 9/27/22. The application was signed by G. Pruitt (landowner consent) 10/7/22 and by P. Shah (applicant) 10/11/22, which is the date of application. P2 is due 3/19/23 (Chk 10602 recorded 3/15/23); P3 is due 6/17/23 (Chk 10688 recorded 6/14/23). KW-01 (Eff. 1/10/23): P1 due 1/17/23 (Chk 10511 dated 1/17/23, cleared 1/19/23). The application was signed by G. Pruitt 3/2/23 and P. Shah 3/7/23 (date of application). P2 is due 7/9/23 and was deferred under Sec. 3.3 by notice dated 7/6/23 to 1/10/24 (library-only export, no corpus carrier). P3 is due 10/7/23. 140/141 join: exactly two option payments post-date an application as of Whitaker's work, KW-02 P2 (3/15/23) and P3 (6/14/23) against the KW-02 application of 10/11/22. KW-01 P1 precedes its application and P2 was deferred. The join needs the KW-02 ledger (443; 444 for schedule) plus the KW-02 packet (441/442/396), or the dates log (packet assembly 9/29/22) plus the ledger. No attachment shows both payment dates and application dates. The ledgers carry no application references, the packets carry no payment status (Tab 5 shows only the Schedule 1 terms), and the dates log carries no payments. 443's two unmatched lines are the same P2/P3, recorded in the Alder ledger but with no matching bank-feed line in the production set. Tom's 6/1/23 'bank-feed lines' (422) versus Brooks's production set is left unresolved (bank records are unknown, §7). Applications become PDF packets because the bodies describe multi-part packets: Tab 1 form + certification + landowner consent; Tab 2 parcel description; Tab 3 Klamath County record extract; Tab 4 Tom's 3/22/22 field notes (from EMAIL-1409); Tab 5 the option as then current (v1 draft for 412, executed scan otherwise). The filename stem is kept (.txt -> .pdf), and the load-file ATTACHMENTS rows are updated. Acreage claimed = Assessor acreage of record (111.87 / 148.62), consistent with ATT-001. There is no survey (none referenced by the bodies), no easement-of-record row, and no credit amount (rate card unknown, §7). Dates log: the lead date 3/16/22 is the seed lead itself (EMAIL-176) and is guard-exempt. Every option, packet and application date is after 3/16/22.
